{{Quote|Have Nuni take all the children and elders to the safe shelter. And Send Viva to gather my medicines. We&hellip; we could need them later. Quickly!|Elan to [[Dana (Galacian)|Dana]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown" />}}
'''Viva''' was a member of the [[Hill people]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]].<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown" /> In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]'' to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].</ref> Viva was tasked by [[Elan Tallah|Elan]], the leader of the Hill people, to gather all of her medicinal supplies when the [[Royal guard (Gala)|royal guards]] [[Battle of Gala|attacked]] the Hill people's encampment.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown" />
